title: the Cape Route Rising
author: Jude Iversen
blurb: Dominic Iversen, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the ice breaks on the river.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
